steps.instruction: In Odoo, open the existing draft quotation for customer '{{runid}} Bench Customer' (the one with a single order line for product 'Corner Desk Left Sit', quantity 3). Add a SECOND order line: pick a DIFFERENT product from the product catalogue via the product dropdown (choose an actual option from the dropdown, not typed text), and set its quantity to 2. Let the app fill in the unit price automatically. Then report: (a) the name of the second product you chose, (b) its unit price, and (c) the new Untaxed Amount shown in the totals. Keep the quotation as a draft — do not confirm it. Verify these values by reading them from the page.

In Odoo, open the existing draft quotation for customer '{{runid}} Bench Customer' (it has two order lines: 'Corner Desk Left Sit' qty 3 and 'Office Chair' qty 2). Change the quantity of the FIRST line (Corner Desk Left Sit) from 3 to 5, leaving the second line unchanged at qty 2. Save/apply the change. Then report the new Untaxed Amount shown in the totals, and also confirm the two line quantities now read 5 and 2. Keep the quotation as a draft — do not confirm it. Verify by reading the values from the page.

In Odoo, open the existing draft quotation for customer '{{runid}} Bench Customer' (two lines: Corner Desk Left Sit qty 5, Office Chair qty 2, Untaxed Amount £565.00) and confirm it so it becomes a sales order. Use the Confirm button (or Confirm Sale as appropriate). After confirming, report: (a) the order reference / name of the record (e.g. something like S00042) shown in the breadcrumb or header, and (b) the status the app now shows for the order (e.g. 'Sales Order' / 'In Progress' or similar). Verify both by reading them from the page.

In Odoo, open the confirmed sales order S00021 for customer '{{runid}} Bench Customer' and cancel it so nothing from this run stays active. Use the Cancel button (if it asks for a cancellation reason, pick/confirm any offered option). After cancelling, report the status the app now shows for the order (e.g. 'Cancelled'). Verify by reading the status from the page.

Verification only, no changes: In Odoo, (1) open the contact '{{runid}} Bench Customer' and report its City field value; (2) open sales order S00021 and report its current status and its Untaxed Amount. Do not edit, save, confirm, or cancel anything — just read and report these values.
